narrative.overview: Windows 11 hierarchy with Fluent 2 controls and bundled Noto typography across desktop and Android. A shared confirmed Mica workspace base with an opaque fallback, settings entries in two columns at workspace widths of 800px and above with side-by-side copy and status at entry widths of 360px and above, explicit selected radio dots, regular explorer commands, and an integrated server search field share the foundations; complex lists and editors preserve their workflows.
keyCharacteristics: Native UI typography and compact working density.
Semantic Fluent themes and local system icons.
Native Windows Mica across persistent chrome and workspace, with 60% content and 55% field materials above it.
Shared menus, file-search previews and dialogs use 72% neutral tint with 20px blur and 1.2 saturation, solid accessibility fallbacks and Smoke modal dimming.
Preserved circular fluid connection action and authentication image transition.

rules.name: One Theme Authority
rules.body: Runtime theme objects own values; legacy variables are aliases only.

rules.name: Material Has a Job
rules.body: Confirmed Mica is shared by persistent chrome and the full workspace base, including file navigation, commands and status, with an opaque fallback, 60% content material and 55% field material. Shared menus, file-search previews and dialogs use cfms-acrylic-surface with 72% neutral tint, 20px blur, 1.2 saturation and Fluent stroke/shadow; unsupported blur, reduced transparency and forced colors use solid surfaces. File address/search outer heights are 32px desktop and 44px coarse pointer. The toolbar says Search in {directory} while preserving server-wide search; the search dialog retains its explicit server-wide placeholder. Smoke dims blocking dialogs on a separately animated sibling layer. Content/field filters paint on pseudo-elements; viewport dialogs and context menus mount at the document body. File navigation adds a per-server/account session history with Alt+Left/Right and keeps Refresh after Search.

rules.name: Sensitive Fields Stay Native
rules.body: Never send a password or private-key passphrase to a reflecting custom text input.

rules.name: Preserve Signature Motion
rules.body: Keep circular connection feedback and the 600ms authentication choreography, with reduced-motion end states.

dos: Use Fluent across platforms and adapt input targets.
Keep security and bilingual copy unchanged.
Validate native Mica in a native client.
donts: Do not maintain independent Material and explorer palettes.
Do not replace business behavior for appearance.
Do not load remote UI assets at runtime.
